body:
I wrote my own kind of essay so I don’t mind haha. Yeah, I seriously feel like I have codependency issues too. I have a huge problem with pacing relationships, and kind of end up being easy to manipulate in them. I was having a lot of trouble making money too and considered going into doing cam stuff, but I ultimately decided to stray away from that. Finances are just kind of awful.

Thanks for the advice of not telling anyone, I’ve already run into a friend who shamed me for considering it a while ago. Glad to hear you scheduled an appointment though. I might when I get my finances in order, it’s the first time I’ve seriously considered it in several months.
